trackerLog.focus: Nested spaces shipped to impl-complete (not verified)

bug.notes: Impl: world-unit ghost/commit. Still waiting on design verify. How to verify: zoom in, drag a small box, ghost matches commit.

bug.title: Undo of space.spawn resets camera instead of rewriting into the restored space
bug.repro: Zoom in until a child space spawns. Undo. Camera jumps to working zoom at origin of the restored parent, not the pre-spawn view.
bug.expected: Undo restores spaces and rewrites camera into the restored space at the matching world point.
bug.actual: spaceId is repaired if missing; camera is resetCamera().
bug.notes: SET-1.5. Camera is session state so undo of document spawn does not include camera. Impl reset to working zoom to avoid child coords in parent space.

set.notes: Impl: inspector values filled (type name x y rot scale lock hide layerId order). Rotate handle. Snap to frame corners, edge midpoints, and center. Undo/redo create/delete/transform/props. Exit not marked; waiting design verify.
Impl: images/SVG/DXF import, DWG stub, assets drawer, import inspector role/replace/detach/relink/flip/rotate/fit plus crop x y w h. Crop is numeric, no in-canvas crop drag.
Impl: fit home/sequence/selection, command palette with later verbs disabled, breadcrumb Project / Sequence / space chain (click to enter), first-run blank/import/Ask Grok disabled.

Impl: spawn child at 1024× home at camera focus; enter existing child if a portal is nearby; zoom out 1/1024× exits to parent or inserts a parent at root. Hysteresis lock against reverse. Portal node saved and locked. Checkerboard/origin/spawn band by flags. Dev panel shows space, camera, ulp, max |coord|, spawn stops, product-to-root DISPLAY ONLY. Objects stay in the space they were created. How to verify: zoom through 1024× until nest increments, draw, zoom out, parent objects unmoved, double-click portal to return.

feature.notes: Dev panel includes product-to-root display-only and live origin/parent.
